protocol: datasets/lwd_v2 first 4000 train / 500 val, 2 epochs, batch 4, SGD lr 1e-3 cosine to 1e-5 over the 2 epochs, gamma=1, float16, cuda:3; checkpoints deleted, logs in runs/pilot_20261109

selection.rule: largest kl_weight whose pilot best val RMSE is within 10% of the best pilot

speed: about 9.5 step/s at 128x128 on V100 (0.105 s/step)
caveats: 2,000 steps only; the 1.9% RMSE difference between the two betas is within run-to-run noise, so the choice mainly follows the rule (larger beta, more regular latent: KL per latent 3.3 vs 4.5).
lwd_v2 is much harder than lwd_v1 (pilot RMSE 0.062 vs 0.026 at the same budget): thin interbeds, 2-4 lithologies, faults and contacts; the high-contrast group dominates the error.
